source_caption:
Malibu's Most Wanted follows Brad “B-Rad” Gluckman, a wealthy politician's son who desperately wants to be a rapper and imitates the hip-hop lifestyle. Worried that Brad's behavior could hurt his political campaign, his father hires two actors to pretend to kidnap him and scare him into changing his ways.

In Malibu's Most Wanted, the story blends comedy and satire while poking fun at stereotypes, wealth, privilege, and celebrity culture. Directed by John Whitesell, the film stars Jamie Kennedy, Taye Diggs, and Anthony Anderson.

source_details.title: Malibu's Most Wanted
source_details.synopsis: Malibu's Most Wanted is a 2003 American comedy film starring and co-written by Jamie Kennedy and co-starring Taye Diggs, Anthony Anderson, Blair Underwood, Regina Hall, Damien Dante Wayans, Ryan O'Neal, and Snoop Dogg. The film is written by the creators of MADtv, Fax Bahr and Adam Small, who also serve as producers. The character of "B-Rad", a spoof of Eminem's character "B-Rabbit" in the film 8 Mile, originally appeared in Jamie Kennedy's hidden-camera show The Jamie Kennedy Experiment, but started in his stand-up routine when he was starting out.
